epfCalc.title: EPF Calculator
epfCalc.subtitle: Project how much your Employees' Provident Fund could grow to by retirement, with yearly pay rises and an interest rate you can change.
faq: How are the contributions worked out?
You contribute 12% of basic plus DA. Your employer also pays 12%, of which 8.33% of wage (capped at a ₹15,000 wage) goes to the pension scheme (EPS) and the rest to EPF. The tool uses this split.
How is interest calculated?
Monthly on the running balance and credited once a year, which is how EPFO describes it. Because the yearly rate is set by the government, you can change it; check the latest declared rate.
Is the result exact?
No. Your employer may contribute differently, the wage cap and rates change, and interest can be taxable above certain contribution limits. Check your EPF passbook for actual figures.
What retirement age should I use?
58 is the age at which EPF is usually fully withdrawable, but you can enter any age.
Is my information sent anywhere?
No. Everything runs in your browser. Nothing you enter is uploaded to {{siteName}}; the page still loads advertising and other resources from the network.

timeZoneConverter.title: Time Zone Converter

faq: Does it handle daylight saving time?
Yes. It uses your browser's time zone data for the date you choose, so a summer date in New York and a winter date can differ by an hour from IST.
Why is India always +5:30?
India does not use daylight saving time, so IST stays UTC+5:30 all year.
What about times that do not exist?
When clocks jump forward an hour, some local times do not occur. If you choose one, the result may be an hour off.
What does the working-hours column mean?
It says whether the converted time is between 9 am and 6 pm in that place, as a quick guide for scheduling a meeting.

faq: What contrast ratio is needed?
WCAG asks for at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text at level AA, and 7:1 and 4.5:1 at level AAA.
What counts as large text?
About 24 px, or about 19 px if bold, and bigger.
Does it accept short hex codes?
Yes. #fff is read as #ffffff.
Why do HSL values look rounded?
HSL is shown in whole numbers, so converting back can change a colour by one step.

faq: What is a UUID?
A universally unique identifier, a 128-bit value written as 32 hexadecimal digits, often used as a database key or a file or request id.
Which version is this?
Version 4, which is made from random numbers.
Is it truly random?
It uses the browser's secure random generator (crypto.randomUUID where available).
Can two be the same?
The chance of a clash among random UUIDs is astronomically small, but a UUID is an identifier and not a secret; do not use it as a password.

faq: What is a Unix timestamp?
The number of seconds since 1 January 1970 00:00 UTC. JavaScript and many APIs use milliseconds instead.
How does it tell seconds from milliseconds?
Numbers with 11 or more digits are read as milliseconds; shorter ones as seconds.
Does the timestamp depend on time zone?
No. A timestamp is the same moment everywhere; only the readable date changes with the time zone.

faq: What is URL encoding?
Replacing characters that are not safe in a URL, such as spaces and &, with a percent sign and two hex digits, for example a space becomes %20.
Which option should I use?
Use "a value or query part" for a single parameter value; use "a whole URL" for a full link so characters like / and ? are kept.
Why does decoding fail?
The text contains a % that is not followed by two hex digits, so it is not valid percent-encoding.
Is + a space?
In query strings, + often means a space, so decoding a value treats it that way.

faq: When is CGST + SGST charged and when IGST?

When the seller and the place of supply are in the same state the tax is split equally into CGST and SGST. When they are in different states IGST is charged. The tool decides this from the two states you select.
What does the GSTIN check do?

It checks the 15-character layout, the state code and the final check character, which catches most typing mistakes. It cannot tell whether the number is registered or active; verify that on the GST portal.
Is this an e-invoice?
No. It does not create an IRN or QR code and does not connect to the GST portal. If your turnover requires e-invoicing, generate that through the official system or your billing software.
What is a bill of supply?

A bill of supply is used instead of a tax invoice when no GST is charged, for example by some composition dealers or for exempt supplies. Choose it to switch off tax. Confirm which document you must issue with a tax professional.
Are my business details saved?

Only if you tick "Remember my business details". They are then kept in this browser on your device, not on our servers, and you can untick the box to remove them. Buyer details and items are never saved.
How is rounding done?
Each rate is rounded to the paisa line by line, and you can round the final total to the nearest rupee with the round-off shown separately.

What does DPI do?
DPI turns a printed size into pixels: 35 × 45 mm at 300 DPI is about 413 × 531 pixels. Online forms usually care about pixels and KB, printers care about DPI.
Does it remove the background or fix the face position?

Almost always. The tool lowers JPG quality as far as needed. If it still cannot reach the limit, it says so instead of pretending it worked.

faq: How is gratuity calculated?
For employers covered by the Payment of Gratuity Act: last monthly basic + DA × 15 ÷ 26 × years of service, where a part-year of 6 months or more counts as a full year.
What if my employer is not covered by the Act?
The formula uses 15 ÷ 30 and completed years only. The tool offers this option.
Who is eligible?
Usually employees who complete five years of continuous service. Exceptions exist, such as death or disability.
Is gratuity taxable?
Gratuity from a private employer is tax-free up to ₹20 lakh under current rules; the excess is taxable. Rules can change, so check the latest provisions.
Can I see gratuity for other lengths of service?
Yes. A table shows the gratuity at 5, 10, 15 up to 35 years of service for the same pay. If you enter less than 5 years, a note explains the usual eligibility rule.

Future value = amount × (1 + rate)^years, with the rate as a yearly percentage.
Is the return guaranteed?
No. Market-linked returns vary every year. The result is only an illustration at one steady rate.
How is this different from SIP?
A lumpsum is invested once. A SIP invests regularly; use the SIP calculator for that.
Can it adjust for inflation?
Yes. Enter an inflation rate to see the future value in today's buying power next to the plain future value.

Future cost = amount × (1 + inflation)^years.

Long-run consumer inflation in India has been roughly 4 to 7 percent a year, but it varies. Education and healthcare often rise faster. Choose a rate that fits what you are planning for.

It is how much the same amount can purchase later. At 6 percent a year, ₹1 lakh buys roughly what ₹56,000 buys today after 10 years.

BMI = weight in kg ÷ (height in metres)².
Why are there two scales?
WHO uses 25 as overweight and 30 as obese. Guidelines for Asian populations use 23 and 25 because health risks rise at lower BMI.
Is BMI accurate?
It is a rough screening number. It does not separate muscle from fat and is not suited to children, pregnancy or athletes.
Is this medical advice?
No. Speak to a doctor for advice about your health.
Does it estimate calories?
Optionally. Enter age, sex and activity level for a daily calorie estimate using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation. It is a rough guide and not dietary advice.
Does it say how much weight to gain or lose?
It shows how far your weight is from the healthy range for your height. A doctor or dietitian can advise what is right for you.

base64.subtitle: Encode or decode UTF-8 text, create URL-safe Base64, or calculate SHA fingerprints for text and files.
faq: Does this tool upload my data to {{siteName}}?
No. Encoding, decoding, and hashing use browser APIs locally. Selected files are read in memory and never uploaded.
Is Base64 encryption?
No. Base64 is a reversible encoding, not encryption. Anyone can decode it; never use it to protect secrets.
Can a hash be reversed?
Cryptographic hashes are designed to be one-way fingerprints. This tool offers SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512. SHA-1 is included for compatibility, not for security-sensitive new designs.
What does URL-safe Base64 change?
It substitutes hyphen and underscore for plus and slash, and omits padding when encoding. This is useful in URLs and filenames; decoding must use the matching option.
Why can’t some Base64 data be decoded as text?
The decoder displays UTF-8 text only. Base64 may represent arbitrary binary data such as an image or archive; that data is not valid UTF-8 text.
Is extracting text safe on {{siteName}}?
Text extraction runs in your browser. The selected PDF is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing; PDF.js may request supporting character-map resources from a content delivery network.
Can this tool read scanned PDFs or photos of text?
This tool extracts embedded digital text. Scanned documents or image-only PDFs require optical character recognition (OCR), which this tool does not support.
Does the extraction preserve layout formatting?
The tool separates extracted text by page, but it does not preserve the exact visual layout, columns, or typography of the PDF.
Is there a limit on how long the document can be?
There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but large PDFs may take longer or exceed available browser memory. Scanned pages are not OCR-processed.

There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but large documents and high render scales may take longer or exceed available browser memory.

organize.subtitle: Reorder, rotate, or delete PDF pages visually in your browser.
faq: Is organizing PDF pages safe on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is rendered and reorganized in your browser; it is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Can I remove specific pages from my PDF?
Yes. Click the trash icon on any page thumbnail to remove that page from the final document.
Will rotating pages affect document quality?
Rotation updates the page's rotation without re-compressing or rasterizing vector text.
Is there a limit on how many pages I can organize?
There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but rendering and reorganizing large PDFs may take longer or exceed available browser memory.

pageNumbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
pageNumbers.subtitle: Add page numbers, headers, and footers to a PDF using your browser.
faq: Does adding page numbers re-render existing text on {{siteName}}?
No. The original page contents, fonts, vector drawings, and images remain untouched. New text streams are overlaid at specified coordinates.
Can I omit the cover or title page?
Yes. Enable the Skip first page checkbox to start numbering from page 2 onward.
Are my confidential documents uploaded to a server?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website may make separate requests for advertising and supporting resources.

watermark.title: Watermark PDF
watermark.subtitle: Add a configurable text watermark to selected PDF pages in your browser.
faq: Are my watermarked documents uploaded to a remote server on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Will the watermark obscure my existing text?
You can reduce the opacity to 10%–25% to make underlying text and graphics easier to read. Review the result before sharing.
Can I watermark only specific pages?
Yes. Select all, odd or even pages, or enter a custom page range (for example 1-5, 8).

nup.title: N-Up PDF (Multiple Pages Per Sheet)
nup.subtitle: Arrange two or four PDF pages on each sheet for handouts and presentation notes.
faq: What is N-Up printing on {{siteName}}?
N-Up scales multiple pages (2 or 4) and positions them on one sheet, reducing the number of sheets required.
Will text or vector drawings lose clarity when scaled?
Pages are embedded as PDF page objects rather than rasterized, so text and vector elements remain scalable. Check the result at your intended print size.
Are my files uploaded anywhere during layout composition?
The selected PDF is arranged in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website may make separate requests for resources and advertising.
What makes {{siteName}} sanitization different from standard PDF editors?

The tool removes the selected document information, XMP metadata, PieceInfo data, page thumbnails, and supported JavaScript actions. It cannot guarantee removal of every kind of hidden information or content embedded in page artwork.
Will sanitizing a PDF alter my visible text, images, or layout?
The tool targets metadata and selected PDF structures, not visible page content. Check the sanitized file and do not rely on it as the sole method for concealing sensitive information.
Are my confidential files uploaded to any server?

The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The tool removes the metadata types described on this page; it cannot guarantee removal of every kind of hidden information.
Does {{siteName}} receive my password or PDF?
The password and selected PDF are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Will the protected PDF retain selectable text and links?

This tool renders each page to an image before rebuilding the PDF. Text may no longer be selectable or searchable, and links, forms, and other interactive features may not be retained. Review the result before replacing your original.
Do the printing and copying permissions prevent every kind of copying?

No. PDF permissions are honored differently by different readers and cannot prevent screenshots or other ways of capturing content. Use a strong password to control opening, and do not treat permission flags as copy-proof security.
Is unlocking PDFs safe on {{siteName}}?
The password and selected PDF are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Do I need to know the document password?
Yes. Enter a password you are authorized to use to open the PDF. This tool cannot recover a forgotten password.
Will unlocking alter the formatting or contents of my PDF?

This tool rebuilds each page as an image. Text may no longer be selectable or searchable, and links, forms, and other interactive features may not be retained. Check the output before replacing your original.
Can I re-encrypt the file later?
Yes. Once unlocked, you can open the Protect PDF tool at any time to assign new passwords or custom permissions.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.subtitle: Beautify, minify, and validate JSON data with clear syntax errors and optional key sorting.
faq: Is my JSON sent to {{siteName}}?
No. Parsing, sorting, and formatting happen locally in your browser. The tool does not evaluate code or make network requests with your JSON.
Does sorting keys change my data?
It changes the order of object keys recursively for readability. Array order and values are retained. Avoid key sorting if the original order is meaningful to your workflow.
Does validation check a schema?
No. Validation checks whether the input is syntactically valid JSON. It does not validate application-specific fields or a JSON Schema.

sample.title: Sample PDF Generator & QA Sandbox
sample.subtitle: Generate sample PDFs with configurable layouts, synthetic test data, and optional malformed-file cases in your browser.
faq: What is the Mixed-Geometry Stress Test?

A single multi-page PDF where each page has a different size or orientation (A4 portrait, A3 landscape blueprint, 90-degree clockwise rotation, and a long mobile POS receipt). It tests if your PDF viewer or thumbnail pipeline handles non-standard pages.
Why would I generate a corrupted PDF?

Software developers and QA engineers need to test error handling when users upload broken or incomplete files. Our chaos modes simulate truncated downloads, invalid magic headers, and scrambled cross-reference tables safely.
Is the Synthetic PII dataset real customer data?

No. The generator creates synthetic names, payment-like numbers, and tax-like identifiers for software testing. They are not real customer data and should not be used for transactions or identity verification.
How does the file size simulation work?
When you select 1 MB, 5 MB, or 10 MB, the generator injects padded binary data streams into the document, allowing you to test file-upload limits without hunting for arbitrary large files.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert Images to PDF
imagesToPdf.subtitle: Assemble JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a PDF using your browser.
faq: Are my photos uploaded to an external server on {{siteName}}?
Selected images are converted in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The site makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Which image formats are supported?
JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported and converted to PDF streams.
Can I change the order of images before making the PDF?
Yes. Use the up and down arrow buttons next to each preview thumbnail to arrange the pages.

inspect.title: PDF Structure & Metadata Inspector
inspect.subtitle: Review PDF version, metadata, encryption status, page geometry, and selected document features in your browser.
faq: Why inspect PDFs on {{siteName}}?
Use the report to review basic PDF structure and look for features such as JavaScript actions. It is not a full security audit, malware scanner, or PDF/A conformance validator.
Are my confidential documents uploaded to a remote server?
The selected PDF is analyzed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Are my images uploaded to {{siteName}}?
No. Your images are decoded and converted in browser memory using HTML Canvas; the files are not sent to our servers.
Which formats can I convert?
This tool accepts PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP, and can output those same formats. SVG is not supported because canvas conversion rasterizes vector artwork.
What happens to transparency?
PNG and WebP can retain transparency. JPG does not support transparency, so transparent areas are filled white.
Does conversion preserve metadata?
No. Canvas re-encoding creates a new image and does not carry over metadata such as EXIF camera or location information.
Are images uploaded to {{siteName}}?
No. Image processing runs locally in browser memory with HTML Canvas. Original files are not modified or uploaded.
Will every image become smaller?
Not necessarily. Some images are already optimized, and lossless PNG output can be larger. Results show the actual size change; try a smaller dimension or a lossy format for a smaller file.
How does the dimension limit work?
The selected maximum applies to the longer side. The original aspect ratio is preserved, and images smaller than the selected limit are not enlarged.
What happens if I convert a transparent image to JPG?
JPG cannot store transparency. Transparent areas are filled with white when producing JPG output.

compress.title: Compress & Optimize PDF
compress.subtitle: Reduce a PDF to a size you choose, or just clean up its structure, in your browser. Size savings depend on the document.
faq: How does PDF compression work on {{siteName}}?

"Clean up only" rewrites the PDF with object streams and removes metadata (Strong also removes XMP metadata, editing information and page thumbnails) and keeps text selectable. "Reduce to a size" first tries that; if the file is still above your limit, it turns each page into a picture and tries sharper-to-smaller settings until it fits.
Will text or vector drawings lose clarity?

Clean-up mode does not touch pages, so the size may be similar to the original. Reduce-to-size mode may turn pages into pictures: the text is then no longer selectable or searchable, and very small limits make pages blurrier. The tool tells you which method it used.
Are my confidential documents uploaded anywhere?
The PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website still makes separate network requests for resources and advertising.
What size limits should I aim for?

It depends on where the file is going, so follow the limit you were given. As a rough guide, email attachments are often capped at about 20–25 MB in total, and many government and job portals ask for roughly 100 KB to 2 MB per file. Use Reduce to a size for these limits; if a limit is too small for the number of pages, the tool says it could not reach it.

crop.title: Crop & Trim PDF
crop.subtitle: Trim outer margins, remove printer bleed marks, and adjust PDF page boundaries in your browser.
faq: How does cropping work on {{siteName}}?
Cropping adjusts the internal CropBox and MediaBox parameters of the PDF. This trims empty white borders, printer bleed marks, or unwanted headers without degrading typography or vector quality.
Are my confidential files uploaded anywhere?
The PDF is cropped in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The site may still make separate requests for advertising and supporting resources.
Can I crop only odd or even pages?
Yes. You can select all pages, odd pages, even pages, or specify a custom page range.

delete.title: Delete PDF Pages
delete.subtitle: Remove unnecessary, blank, or confidential pages from a PDF using your browser.
faq: Is it safe to delete pages from confidential PDFs on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. Advertising and other site requests are separate from the file operation.
Can I remove the cover page or blank trailing pages?
Yes. Use the quick buttons for the first or last page, or type comma-separated values like 1, 10 to remove them.
Will deleting pages affect document links or quality?
The tool removes selected pages without rasterizing the remaining page content. Check forms, links, or other document features in the saved copy.

sections.heading: What the EPF Calculator does
paragraphs: It projects your provident fund balance by adding your monthly contributions and your employer's EPF share, growing them with interest, and raising your wage each year by the percentage you choose.

sections.heading: How the projection works
paragraphs: Each month your contribution (12% of wage) and your employer's EPF share (12% minus the EPS part) are added, interest accrues on the running balance each month at the yearly rate divided by 12, and the accrued interest is added at the end of the year.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: The interest rate is declared each year and changes. The EPS wage cap, tax rules for interest and your employer's contribution structure may differ from the assumptions here. Treat the result as an estimate.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Time Zone Converter does
paragraphs: It takes a date and time in one time zone and shows what it is in others, which helps with meetings, calls and deadlines across countries.

sections.heading: Daylight saving
paragraphs: Many countries change their clocks. The converter applies the rules for the date you pick, using the time zone database built into your browser.

sections.heading: Scheduling tip
paragraphs: The table marks each zone as inside or outside 9 am to 6 pm so you can find an hour that works for everyone. Choose the time zone carefully, since abbreviations such as IST can mean different zones.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The conversion runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It creates filler text of the length you choose, so you can fill a design, template or web page while the real content is not ready.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Choose paragraphs and sentences, optionally start with "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet", pick plain text or HTML and copy the result.

sections.heading: Remember to replace it
paragraphs: Placeholder text should never be published. Replace it with real content before a page goes live.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The text is made in your browser and nothing is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Color Converter does
paragraphs: It converts a colour between HEX, RGB and HSL and gives you CSS-ready text to copy.

sections.heading: The contrast checker
paragraphs: Readable text needs enough difference in brightness between text and background. The checker uses the WCAG formula, shows the ratio and tells you whether it passes AA and AAA for normal and large text.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: The ratio says nothing about colour blindness, font weight or size beyond the large-text rule. Test real designs with real users where you can.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Colours are converted in your browser and nothing is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the UUID Generator does
paragraphs: It creates version 4 UUIDs, the random kind, and lets you format them the way your code or database expects.

sections.heading: Formats
paragraphs: The standard form has hyphens in the groups 8-4-4-4-12. Some systems want no hyphens, capitals or curly braces, so you can choose.

sections.heading: Not a secret
paragraphs: A UUID is good for unique identifiers but is not designed as a password or access token.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: UUIDs are generated in your browser and are not sent or stored by MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It converts between Unix timestamps and readable dates, useful for reading logs, API responses and database fields.

sections.heading: Seconds and milliseconds
paragraphs: Many systems use seconds, while JavaScript and some APIs use milliseconds. The tool reads long numbers as milliseconds so you rarely need to convert by hand.

sections.heading: Time zones
paragraphs: The same timestamp shows different clock times in different places. The tool shows UTC, India time and your browser's time zone.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Conversion happens in your browser and nothing is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the URL Encoder does
paragraphs: It converts text to and from percent-encoding, which is how special characters are written inside URLs.

sections.heading: Value or whole URL
paragraphs: Encoding a single value escapes characters like /, ? and &, which is what you want inside a query string. Encoding a whole URL leaves those characters alone so the link still works.

sections.heading: Reading query strings
paragraphs: If the text is a full link, the tool lists its query parameters in a table, which is handy for debugging.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Conversion happens in your browser and nothing is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the GST Invoice Generator does
paragraphs: It lays out a GST tax invoice or a bill of supply and does the arithmetic: line totals with discounts, CGST and SGST or IGST by rate, a tax summary, the round-off and the amount in words. When you are done you print the page and save it as a PDF.

sections.heading: What goes on a tax invoice
paragraphs: Typically the seller's name, address and GSTIN, a unique invoice number and date, the buyer's details, place of supply, a description of each item with its HSN or SAC code, quantity, value, tax rate and tax amount, and the total. The exact requirements depend on your registration and the type of supply, so check the current rules.

sections.heading: Limits to know about
paragraphs: This tool does not file GST returns, create e-invoices (IRN and QR code), check that a GSTIN is registered or choose the correct HSN code or rate for you. It rounds each rate to the paisa line by line, which can differ by a paisa from billing software that rounds differently.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The invoice is built in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils. Your business details are stored only if you choose to remember them, and only in this browser.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It crops a photo from the centre to a passport-style size (35 × 45 mm by default), converts that size to pixels at the DPI you set, and compresses the JPG to stay under your size limit.

sections.heading: Choosing the right values
paragraphs: Change the unit to millimetres, centimetres, inches or pixels, set the DPI for printed sizes and set the maximum KB. A quick preset button fills these in for common cases.

sections.heading: What it does not do
paragraphs: It does not change the background, retouch or check that your photo meets passport rules such as face position, expression or lighting. Forms and exams change their rules, so always check the size, file size and format written on your own form before uploading.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your photo is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It scales a signature image to an exact pixel size and compresses it under a small file-size limit, such as 20 KB.

sections.heading: Getting a good result
paragraphs: Use dark ink on white paper, even lighting and a close crop. For a different shape than the target size, choose 'Fit inside with white borders' rather than cropping.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: The output is a JPG with a white background. Forms and exams change their rules, so always check the size, file size and format written on your own form before uploading.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your image is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It crops a photo to an exact pixel size and compresses it under a KB limit, which is what many application forms ask for.

sections.heading: Before you upload
paragraphs: Match the size, KB limit and format to your exam notification. Some forms also want a plain background and specific face position, which this tool does not check.

sections.heading: Related tools
paragraphs: Use the signature resizer for signatures and the image compressor if you only need a smaller file without a fixed size.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your photo is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It re-encodes your picture as a JPG and searches for the highest quality that fits under 30 KB, scaling down in small steps only when quality alone is not enough.

sections.heading: Tips for small files
paragraphs: Crop closely, avoid busy backgrounds and use a plain well-lit picture; these compress far better than detailed photos.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: The output is always a JPG. Forms and exams change their rules, so always check the size, file size and format written on your own form before uploading.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your image is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What the Gratuity Calculator does
paragraphs: It estimates the gratuity an employer pays when you leave after long service. Enter your last monthly basic plus dearness allowance and your length of service.

sections.heading: How the figure is worked out
paragraphs: For covered employers the amount is last pay × 15 ÷ 26 × years, with a part-year of six months or more rounded up. For others it is last pay × 15 ÷ 30 × completed years.

sections.heading: Before you rely on it
paragraphs: Your employer may pay more than the legal minimum, and tax rules and limits are revised from time to time. Check your appointment letter and current law.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A table of gratuity at different lengths of service, an eligibility note, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Lumpsum Calculator does
paragraphs: It shows how a single investment could grow over time at an assumed yearly return, using the compound growth formula.

sections.heading: How to use it sensibly
paragraphs: Try a few different rates, including a low one, to see a range rather than a single hopeful number. Remember that charges and taxes will reduce what you keep.

sections.heading: Related tools
paragraphs: Use the SIP calculator for monthly investing and the CAGR calculator to work out the growth rate of an investment you already have.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Inflation-adjusted value, a year-by-year growth table, an invested-versus-gain bar, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Inflation Calculator does
paragraphs: It projects how prices rise over time and how much an amount of money loses in buying power.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Savings that earn less than inflation lose real value. The calculator helps when planning for retirement, a child's education or a large purchase years away.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: Inflation differs by year, city and type of spending, so treat the result as a planning guide, not a forecast.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A year-by-year table, the share of buying power lost, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the BMI Calculator does
paragraphs: It turns your weight and height into a body mass index, names the category and shows the weight range that matches a normal BMI for your height.

sections.heading: Indian and WHO categories
paragraphs: Because health risks appear at lower BMI in South Asian populations, the Asian scale calls 23 and above overweight. You can switch to the WHO scale if you prefer.

sections.heading: What BMI cannot tell you
paragraphs: It ignores muscle, bone, age and where fat is carried. Treat it as a starting point for a conversation with a doctor, not a diagnosis.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Distance from the healthy range, an optional calorie estimate, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Bill Splitter does
paragraphs: The page has two modes. Equal split divides a bill, plus an optional tip or service charge, equally among everyone at the table. Group settle-up is for trips and shared costs where different people paid for different things and not everyone shared everything.

In Group settle-up you add the people, then each expense with an amount, who paid and who shared it. The page works out what each person paid and what their share was, and shows the smallest set of payments that makes everyone even. You can send the result as a picture or as text.

sections.heading: Tips for fair splitting
paragraphs: Check whether service charge is already on the bill. If people ordered very different amounts or someone paid for part of it, use Group settle-up instead of forcing an equal split.

sections.heading: Rounding
paragraphs: Amounts are counted in hundredths and divided so that the shares always add up exactly to the total. When an amount cannot divide evenly, such as 100 between three people, the extra hundredth goes to a different person on each expense, so it does not fall on the same person every time.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Rounding of each share, an optional currency sign, copy and print buttons, a shareable picture of the settle-up, unequal portions for each expense, and automatic saving on your own device.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: It shows simple interest and compound interest for the same principal, rate and period, so you can see the gap between them. Choose how often interest compounds to match a loan, deposit or savings scheme.

sections.heading: Why compounding matters
paragraphs: With simple interest the same amount is earned every year. With compound interest each period's interest joins the balance and earns interest too. The longer the period and the higher the rate, the bigger the difference.

sections.heading: Good to know
paragraphs: Real products differ in how they count days, round amounts and pay interest. Use this for planning and comparing options, then check the exact terms with the lender or bank.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A year-by-year table, a principal-versus-interest bar, and buttons to copy a short summary or print the page (the print dialog can save it as a PDF).

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the RD Calculator does
paragraphs: It estimates what a recurring deposit will be worth at maturity. Enter the monthly amount, the interest rate and the number of months to see the maturity value and the interest earned.

sections.heading: How the maths works
paragraphs: Every instalment is compounded quarterly from the month it is deposited until maturity. Earlier instalments earn interest for longer, so they contribute more of the total interest.

sections.heading: Before you rely on it
paragraphs: Banks and post offices may differ in compounding, rounding and late-payment rules. Interest is taxable. Check your scheme's terms for the exact maturity figure.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A growth table, a deposits-versus-interest bar, and buttons to copy a summary or print the page.

sections.heading: Interest after tax
paragraphs: Recurring deposit interest is taxable like FD interest. Enter your tax rate to see the interest and the maturity amount you keep after tax. The figure is an estimate: your bank may deduct TDS on the way, and the final tax depends on your total income.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the CAGR Calculator does
paragraphs: It converts a starting and an ending value into one yearly growth rate. That makes investments held for different lengths of time easy to compare.

sections.heading: What CAGR does not show
paragraphs: CAGR smooths out the ups and downs between the start and the end. It says nothing about risk and it ignores money added or withdrawn during the period.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Use the same start and end dates when comparing funds or assets, and remember that past growth does not guarantee future returns.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Doubling time, a table of what the same rate would imply for later years, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Age Calculator does
paragraphs: It tells you exactly how old someone is in years, months and days on any date, plus the total number of days lived and the countdown to the next birthday.

sections.heading: When it helps
paragraphs: Exam and job forms often ask for age on a particular cut-off date. Set the "Age on" date to that day to get the answer instantly.

sections.heading: How it counts
paragraphs: The calculator counts whole years, then whole months, then days, using calendar dates only. Leap years are handled correctly.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Quick cut-off dates, age in months, weeks and days, birth weekday, next-birthday weekday, sun sign, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Checking age eligibility for a form or exam
paragraphs: Open the eligibility box, enter the minimum and maximum age from the notice, and set the Age on date to the cut-off date. The calculator says whether you are within the limit on that date and shows the first day you are old enough and the last day you are still within the upper limit.

Notices word the upper limit in two common ways. "Maximum 30 years" is usually read as allowed up to the day before you turn 31, while "below 30 years" means you must not have turned 30. Pick the option that matches your notice, and add any relaxation years for your category. The notice itself is always the final word.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What this tool does
paragraphs: It measures the time between two dates in several ways at once: years, months and days; total days; weeks; and working days.

sections.heading: Common uses
paragraphs: Notice periods, project deadlines, loan or deposit periods, pregnancy and travel planning, and finding how many days remain until an event.

sections.heading: Things to remember
paragraphs: The end date is not counted, and working days ignore public holidays and local weekly offs.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: An add-or-subtract mode with weekday, an option to count both dates, hours, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Percentage Calculator does
paragraphs: It answers the three most common percentage questions without you needing to remember formulas: a percent of a number, one number as a percent of another, and the percent change between two values.

sections.heading: Examples
paragraphs: 15% of 2,400 is 360. 45 out of 180 is 25%. A price moving from 80 to 100 is a 25% increase.

sections.heading: Tip
paragraphs: A percentage increase followed by the same percentage decrease does not bring you back to the start, because the second percentage applies to a different base.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Increase/decrease by a percentage and the reverse-percentage question, in addition to the three basic calculations.

sections.heading: Reading the working
paragraphs: Under every answer you will see the sum that produced it, such as 15 ÷ 100 × 2,400. That makes it easy to check the result, or to repeat the same calculation by hand in an exam or on an invoice.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Discount Calculator does
paragraphs: It turns a price and a percentage off into the final price you pay and the amount you save, including a second discount such as a coupon.

sections.heading: Why stacked discounts are smaller than they look
paragraphs: Each discount applies to the price left after the previous one, so percentages do not simply add up. The effective discount figure shows the true total.

sections.heading: Related tools
paragraphs: Use the GST calculator to add or remove tax and the percentage calculator for other percentage questions.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Reverse mode (original price from sale price), optional GST, and copy and print buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Unit Converter does
paragraphs: It converts between units of the same kind: length, weight, area, volume, speed, data size and temperature.

sections.heading: Indian units included
paragraphs: Area includes acre, hectare, square foot and square yard, and weight includes quintal and tonne, which are common in property, farming and trade.

sections.heading: Notes
paragraphs: Local units like bigha or gaj differ between states and are not included. Temperature uses the standard Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin formulas.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A swap button, a table of the value in every unit of the type, and a copy button for the result.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The calculation runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Word Counter does
paragraphs: It counts words, characters with and without spaces, sentences and paragraphs, and estimates how long the text takes to read or speak.

sections.heading: Common uses
paragraphs: Essays with word limits, social posts with character limits, speeches, SEO copy and application forms.

sections.heading: Counting rules
paragraphs: Words are separated by whitespace. Sentences end at a full stop, question mark, exclamation mark or danda. Paragraphs are separated by blank lines.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Keyword counts and length-limit bars for common platforms. The limits are typical published values and platforms can change them.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Counting happens in your browser and your text is never uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Case Converter does
paragraphs: It rewrites text in a different letter case in one tap, including the naming styles programmers use for variables and URLs.

sections.heading: Writing styles and code styles
paragraphs: Title case and sentence case suit headings and prose. camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case and kebab-case suit code, file names and web addresses.

The URL slug style makes a web address part from a title: it lowercases the text, removes accents on Latin letters (café becomes cafe), drops apostrophes and joins the words with hyphens. Letters from other scripts, such as Hindi or Cyrillic, are kept as they are. CONSTANT_CASE (upper case with underscores) is common for settings and environment variables, and dot.case for keys in configuration files.

sections.heading: Limits
paragraphs: Title case capitalises every word and does not apply style-guide exceptions. Accented and non-Latin letters follow the browser's Unicode rules.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Toggle and alternating case, "use result as input", and text clean-up buttons.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Conversion happens in your browser and your text is never uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the tool does
paragraphs: It writes an amount in rupees as words, the way it appears on cheques, invoices and receipts, with the word "Only" at the end.

sections.heading: Indian and international systems
paragraphs: The Indian system groups digits as thousand, lakh and crore. The international system uses thousand, million and billion. Pick the one your document needs.

sections.heading: Check before you use it
paragraphs: Always compare the wording with the figure. Amounts are rounded to the nearest paisa.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: Rupees-and-paise or plain-number output, three letter styles, and the figure shown with grouped digits for comparison.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Conversion happens in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded to MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What the Password Generator does
paragraphs: It creates random passwords from the character types you choose. Every ticked type is guaranteed to appear at least once.

sections.heading: Why random is better
paragraphs: People pick predictable passwords. A random one of 16 or more characters is far harder to guess. The page shows an estimate of its strength in bits.

sections.heading: Keeping passwords safe
paragraphs: Use a unique password per account, save it in a reputable password manager and turn on two-step verification where available.

sections.heading: Extras on this page
paragraphs: A strength meter, a guess-time estimate, bulk generation and a numeric PIN mode.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Passwords are generated in your browser with the secure random source and are never sent anywhere or stored by MyDailyUtils.

sections.heading: What Digitize Documents does
paragraphs: Digitize Documents turns photos or scans of paper documents into PDFs that contain a searchable text layer. You add PNG, JPG or WebP images, arrange them as pages, edit them if needed, and export either one combined PDF or one PDF per image. It is built on the same page editor as Master Document Studio, but this version accepts images only, not PDF or Word files.

sections.heading: Editing and output options
paragraphs: Each page can be reordered, rotated, cropped and blacked out before export. Document settings include title, author, subject and keywords, page size (A4, Letter or keep the original size), page margins of 0, 10 or 20 mm, optional page numbers, an optional text watermark, and a compression mode: Maximum quality, Balanced, or a size goal of under 2 MB or under 500 KB. The Output menu offers One PDF or Separate PDFs delivered together in a ZIP file. Size goals are estimates, and the tool tells you if a file ends up above the goal.

sections.heading: Getting better recognition
paragraphs: Text recognition is English only and runs on the pages as you edit them. It works best on straight, evenly lit, high-contrast images, so crop away borders and rotate pages upright before exporting. Each page is rendered for recognition at up to 2x scale, capped near 4000 pixels on the longest side, so very small text in a low-resolution photo will not improve by exporting. Always read through the result: OCR can misread characters, tables and handwriting, and the page image itself stays unchanged underneath the invisible text.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Recognition uses Tesseract running in your browser. The OCR engine and English language data are served from this site and are loaded when needed, so the first run needs a connection and takes extra time; your images are not sent anywhere for recognition. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing. Password protection is not offered here because the protection tool converts pages to images, which would remove the searchable text. Large batches use a lot of memory and time, and you can cancel while recognition is running.

sections.heading: What Generate Sample PDF does
paragraphs: Generate Sample PDF creates placeholder PDF files for testing, such as checking an upload form, a viewer or a processing script. Nothing is read from your own files. You pick a template, a page count and a few optional features, and the file is built in your browser and downloaded. All content is made-up sample text, and the PDFs use standard built-in fonts.

sections.heading: Templates and options
paragraphs: Templates are Invoice / Statement, Multi-Page Article, Legal Contract / NDA, Synthetic PII / DLP (mock personal data and card numbers), Mixed Geometry Stress (A4, A3, rotated and POS-sized pages), Technical Spec Sheet and Minimal Ingest File. The page count slider runs from 1 to 50, with 3 pages by default, and you can change the title shown on the document. The Mixed Geometry template always produces at least 4 pages. Optional features are a bookmarks tree, a small sample graphic, an interactive form, and highlights with URL links.

sections.heading: Size padding and broken files
paragraphs: Target File Size can be Standard (small, roughly 50 KB), 1 MB, 5 MB or 10 MB. To reach the target the tool attaches a filler file named test_payload.dat to the PDF, so the larger file is mostly padding and not extra page content. The chaos options deliberately damage the output so you can test error handling: Cutoff EOF keeps only the first 60 percent of the bytes, Broken Magic Byte overwrites the start of the header, and Scrambled XRef overwrites a short run of bytes near the end. Those files are meant to fail in most readers, so keep them clearly named.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The synthetic PII template uses invented values on internal example domains, but treat any file with realistic-looking card or ID patterns carefully so it is not mistaken for real data. If you change settings after generating, the tool marks the earlier download as outdated and asks you to regenerate. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing. Large size targets need that much memory in the browser while the file is built.

sections.heading: What Rotate PDF does
paragraphs: Rotate PDF turns pages of a PDF by a fixed angle and saves a new file. It changes the page rotation setting stored in the PDF, so text and graphics stay as they were and nothing is converted to an image. The rotation is added to whatever rotation a page already has, which means a page that is already turned 90 degrees and then rotated 90 more ends up at 180.

sections.heading: Rotation options
paragraphs: Angle can be 90, 180 or 270 degrees, with 90 selected by default. Scope decides which pages are affected: All pages, Odd pages, Even pages, or Custom. Custom takes a list such as 1-3, 5, 8-10. Odd and even refer to page numbers counted from 1, so odd means pages 1, 3, 5 and so on. Numbers outside the document are ignored. The tool shows the page count and file size once the file loads.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: For a scanned stack where every page is sideways, use All pages with 90 or 270, depending on which way the page needs to turn. For a mixed document, preview the file first and then use Custom for just the sideways pages. If alternate pages from a duplex scan came out upside down, use Odd or Even with 180. If you rotate the wrong way, run it again with the opposite angle, or with 90 three times, since the angles add up.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load, and the tool reports that it could not read the file. In that case unlock the file first. Rotation does not fix the text direction of scanned images inside the pages, it only changes how the page is displayed. The original file is not modified; you download a separate copy. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Delete PDF Pages does
paragraphs: Delete PDF Pages removes the pages you list from a PDF and gives you the remaining pages as a new file. The remaining pages are kept as they are, with no conversion to images, so text stays selectable and the page layout is unchanged. The tool shows the total page count and file size once the file is loaded.

sections.heading: How to enter pages
paragraphs: You type the pages to remove as comma-separated numbers and ranges, for example 1, 3, 5-7. Spaces are ignored, ranges can be written in either order, and page numbers start at 1. Any number beyond the last page is skipped without an error. If nothing valid is left after parsing, the tool stops with a message that no valid pages were designated. It will also refuse to delete every page, because the result must keep at least one.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: Check the page numbers against the printed numbers in the document, since a cover or front matter can make the PDF page number differ from the number printed on the page. To remove a whole section, use one range such as 10-24 instead of listing pages. If you only want to keep a few pages, the Split tool is usually quicker than deleting almost everything. After downloading, open the result and check the page count and the page that now follows each gap.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load with a message that the file could not be read. Deleting pages does not scrub the file of other content. Bookmarks, form fields or links that pointed to removed pages may still be stored in the file or lose their target, depending on how the original was built, so use the Sanitize tool if hidden data matters. The original file is left unchanged. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Add Page Numbers does
paragraphs: Add Page Numbers prints a number on the pages of an existing PDF and saves a new file. The numbers are drawn on top of each page as text, in a dark grey color, and the original page content is not changed or re-rendered. It uses one of three standard fonts built into PDF viewers, so no font files are loaded.

sections.heading: Settings
paragraphs: Position can be bottom center (the default), bottom left, bottom right, top left, top center or top right. Format can be number only, Page X of Y (the default), X / Y, or - X -. Font choices are Helvetica, Helvetica Bold and Courier. Font size ranges from 8 to 16 points, with 10 as the default. Margin from the page edge ranges from 15 to 60 points, default 30. Start number accepts 1 to 9999 and defaults to 1. A Skip first page option leaves the first page without a number. Under Pages to number you can choose All pages or Selected pages only, and then type a range such as 2-5, 8; pages outside the range get no number.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: For a report with a cover, turn on Skip first page. Note that the count only advances on pages that actually receive a number, so with the default start of 1 the second page shows 1 when all pages are numbered, while with Selected pages only each label follows the page's position in the file; set the start number to 2 if you want the second page to show 2. For double-sided printing, bottom center avoids any left or right swap. Use a larger margin if the document will be trimmed or bound, and check that the number does not overlap footer text already on the page.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Numbers are placed relative to the page size, so pages with unusual crop boxes or rotated pages may show the number in an unexpected corner. The total in Page X of Y is the full page count of the file. Only plain Latin digits and letters in the standard fonts are drawn. Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Watermark PDF does
paragraphs: Watermark PDF writes a line of text across the pages of a PDF, such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT, and saves a new file. The text is added as vector text on top of the existing page content, so the pages are not converted to images. A watermark is a visual notice, not a protection: anyone with a PDF editor can remove it.

sections.heading: Watermark settings
paragraphs: Text defaults to CONFIDENTIAL and cannot be empty. Font size ranges from 18 to 96 points, default 48. Rotation ranges from -90 to 90 degrees in steps of 5, default 45. Opacity ranges from 5 to 100 percent, default 25. The color picker starts at red. Font choices are Helvetica, Helvetica Bold (the default) and Courier. Pages can be All, Odd, Even or Custom, where Custom takes ranges like 1-3, 5. The text is centered on each page.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: Low opacity of 15 to 30 percent keeps body text readable underneath. A mid-grey or light color is less distracting than saturated red on long documents. Keep the text short, because a single line is not wrapped; a long phrase at a large size can run off the edge of the page, so lower the font size or rotation and check the downloaded result. Because the watermark sits above the content, it can cover small text and signatures.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The watermark is always placed on top of the content; there is no setting to put it behind. Only the characters supported by the standard fonts are drawn, so text with non-Latin scripts may fail. Password-protected or damaged PDFs may not load. The original is not changed. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Crop PDF does
paragraphs: Crop PDF trims the margins of a PDF by changing the visible area of each page. You set how much to remove from the top, bottom, left and right, and the tool saves a new file. Text and graphics are not re-rendered or turned into images.

sections.heading: Crop settings
paragraphs: Margins are entered in points, millimetres or inches, with 20 points on each side as the default. A link option keeps all four sides equal. Scope can be All pages, Odd pages, Even pages or Custom, with ranges like 2-5, 9. The same margins apply to every selected page. The tool will stop with an error if a page would be left narrower or shorter than 50 points, and it names the page number that is too small.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: One inch is 72 points and 25.4 millimetres, so 10 mm is about 28 points. To remove scanner borders, start with small values and check the result, then increase. For books where left and right margins differ, crop odd and even pages separately. Because the same margins apply to every selected page, documents with mixed page sizes need care; the 50 point minimum is checked against each page's own size.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Cropping hides content outside the new box but does not delete it. The tool sets both the crop box and the media box of the page, yet the page content that fell outside is usually still stored in the file, so do not use it to remove confidential material; use the Master Document Studio blackout feature, which renders those pages as images, or similar redaction for that. Page rotation and unusual existing crop boxes can change which edge a margin affects. Password-protected files may not load. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Sanitize PDF does
paragraphs: Sanitize PDF removes hidden information that a PDF can carry beyond the visible pages, and shows a list of what it removed. It works by editing the structure of the file in your browser and saving it again; pages are not converted to images, so text stays selectable.

sections.heading: What can be removed
paragraphs: Six switches are all on by default. Document info clears title, author, subject, keywords, creator and producer. XMP metadata removes the extended metadata stream from the document catalog. PieceInfo removes application-specific data that some editors leave behind. Thumbnails removes stored page preview images and page-level PieceInfo. Scripts removes document-level JavaScript, the OpenAction entry and additional-action handlers. Attachments removes the embedded files list and the associated files array.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Turn everything on before sharing a file outside your team, then use Inspect PDF on the result to confirm the flags are cleared. If a form relies on scripts for calculations, turn Scripts off for that run. If the result shows only a note about standardized structure, the file had none of the selected items. The result also shows the original and new file sizes.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: This is not a full redaction or forensics tool. It does not remove or inspect text, images, annotations, comments, form field values, bookmarks, page labels, JavaScript attached to individual form fields or annotations, or hidden layers, and visible content stays exactly as it was. Dates and any other fields outside the listed items are not specifically cleared. Encrypted files are opened without decrypting, so results on them are not guaranteed. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What N-up PDF does
paragraphs: N-up PDF places several pages of a PDF on one sheet, such as two or four pages per sheet, to save paper or make a handout. Pages are placed as scaled copies, so text stays vector and selectable, and the new file is saved with fresh sheets of the paper size you choose.

sections.heading: Layout settings
paragraphs: Layout is 2-up or 4-up. Paper size is A4 landscape (the default), A4 portrait, Letter landscape or Letter portrait. Spacing between pages ranges from 5 to 30 points, default 15. Draw borders is on by default and outlines each placed page with a thin grey line. The sheet margin is fixed at 20 points and is not adjustable. For 2-up, landscape sheets put pages side by side and portrait sheets stack them; 4-up is a 2 by 2 grid, filled left to right and then down.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: For slides, use 4-up on A4 portrait or 2-up on A4 landscape depending on the shape of your pages. For ordinary portrait pages, 2-up in landscape makes the best use of the sheet. Each page is scaled to fit its cell without changing proportions and centered, so mixed page sizes will leave different gaps. Turn off borders if the pages already have their own frames. Check the printed size before relying on small text at 4-up.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The tool does not reorder pages into booklet or imposition order; pages follow the original order. Links and form fields on the source pages may not carry over reliably, and the output is made of embedded copies of the pages. Large documents use more browser memory because each page is embedded separately. Password-protected or damaged PDFs may not load. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Inspect PDF does
paragraphs: Inspect PDF reads a PDF and reports what it contains, without changing it. It is useful for checking a file before sharing it, or for troubleshooting why a file behaves oddly. Nothing is edited or saved; you only see the report.

sections.heading: What the report shows
paragraphs: The report lists file size, the PDF version from the file header, page count, and whether the file is encrypted. It shows document info fields: title, author, subject, creator, producer, creation date and modification date. It flags whether the file has XMP metadata, embedded page thumbnails, JavaScript or automatic actions, and embedded file attachments. A per-page table lists width and height in points, rotation, and the simplified aspect ratio for every page.

sections.heading: Using the results
paragraphs: Dates are shown in ISO format and are in UTC, so they may differ from what another viewer displays. Page sizes are in points, 72 per inch, so A4 is about 595 by 842. If a file shows unexpected pages sizes, mixed rotations or attachments, you may want to run Sanitize PDF or Organize PDF next. The JavaScript flag also turns on when the file has an open action or additional actions, so it means may contain automatic actions, not that script code was found.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: The checks look at the document catalog and page entries only. It does not scan page content, fonts, images or annotations, and it cannot tell you whether a file is safe or contains malware. For encrypted files the tool opens the structure without decrypting, so some fields may be missing or unreadable, and it reports that the file may be encrypted or corrupted if parsing fails. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Protect PDF does
paragraphs: Protect PDF adds a password to a PDF. Importantly, it does this by rebuilding the document: every page is drawn to an image at twice normal scale, saved as a JPEG at 92 percent quality, and the images are assembled into a new encrypted PDF. The result looks like the original but is no longer the original file structure.

sections.heading: Settings
paragraphs: You can set a Document Open password (needed to open the file) and an Owner password. At least one is required; if only an open password is given, it is also used as the owner password. Two checkboxes control permissions: allow printing (on by default, high resolution) and allow copying (off by default). Editing, annotating, filling forms and document assembly are always switched off in the output. Encryption is applied by the pdfmake library used by the tool; the code does not select a particular algorithm or key length, so do not assume the strength of a modern dedicated tool.

sections.heading: What to expect
paragraphs: Because pages become images, text can no longer be selected, searched or copied, links, bookmarks and form fields are lost, and the file is often larger, especially for text-only documents. The original page size of the first page is used for the whole file, so mixed page sizes may not be preserved exactly. Permission flags such as no copying are requests that a PDF viewer is expected to respect; they are not a strong barrier, and the open password is the real protection. Choose a long, unique password and store it, because it cannot be recovered.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: A PDF that already has a password is refused with a message to unlock it first. Very long documents take time and memory, since each page is rendered. For some fonts, PDF.js may request character map files from the jsDelivr CDN; the document itself is not sent. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing. Keep your unprotected original.

sections.heading: What Unlock PDF does
paragraphs: Unlock PDF opens a password-protected PDF using the password you provide and saves a copy without a password. The tool does not guess, bypass or crack passwords; you must supply the correct one. It is meant for files you are allowed to open.

sections.heading: How it works
paragraphs: The only setting is the password. If the file needs one and the field is empty, the tool asks you to enter it; a wrong password is reported as incorrect. After the file opens, each page is drawn to an image at twice normal scale, saved as a JPEG at 92 percent quality, and the pages are assembled into a new PDF with no encryption and no permission restrictions. So the unlocked copy is a rebuilt, image-based version of the document.

sections.heading: What changes in the copy
paragraphs: Text in the new file cannot be selected, searched or copied, and links, bookmarks and form fields are not kept. The file size may be larger or smaller than the original, depending on its content. The page size of the first page is used throughout, so documents with mixed page sizes may not be preserved exactly. If you need to keep the text, ask the sender for an unprotected copy instead.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Files that open without a password still go through the same image conversion. Very large documents may be slow or run out of memory. Do not use this tool to remove protection from documents you have no right to open. For some fonts, PDF.js may request character map files from the jsDelivr CDN; the document itself is not sent. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing. The password you type is used only to open the file in your browser.

sections.heading: What Flatten PDF does
paragraphs: Flatten PDF turns the fillable form fields in a PDF into fixed page content, so the entries you typed or the checkboxes you ticked can no longer be edited. It works on the file structure in your browser, so other pages content is not re-rendered or turned into images.

sections.heading: What it flattens
paragraphs: The tool finds form fields such as text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons and drop-downs and flattens them with the pdf-lib library, then reports how many fields it found. There are no settings: you add the file and download the result. The output is saved without compressed object streams, which can make the file slightly larger than the input.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Fill in the form completely, and check each value in your PDF viewer, before flattening, because there is no way to edit it afterwards in this form. Flatten before emailing a signed or completed form so recipients cannot change the answers. Keep the fillable original in case you need to correct anything. If the report says no fields were found, the PDF either has no fillable form or uses a form type this library could not read, and the file is saved unchanged apart from rewriting.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Only form fields are flattened. Comments, highlights, stamps and other annotations are not flattened by this tool, and flattening does not remove metadata or hidden data, and it is not a digital signature feature; existing digital signatures may become invalid when the file is rewritten. Appearance depends on the appearance data stored in the original form. Password-protected files are opened without decrypting and may fail or give unreliable results. Remember that a flattened form is easy to edit again with a PDF editor. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Extract Text does
paragraphs: Extract Text reads the text that is stored inside a PDF and shows it page by page, with a Copy button and a Download .txt button. It reads the text layer that already exists in the file; it does not do OCR. If a PDF is a scan or a photo, there is no text to read, and the tool tells you that the pages might be scanned images.

sections.heading: How the output is built
paragraphs: Each page is introduced by a line such as --- Page 3 ---, followed by the text of that page. Text pieces are joined with single spaces in the order the PDF stores them, and no extra formatting is added. There are no settings. The downloaded file is named after your PDF with _text.txt added.

sections.heading: Using the results
paragraphs: Expect imperfect results for complex layouts. Columns, tables, headers and footers can come out in an odd order or run together, because the PDF stores positioned fragments and not paragraphs, and line breaks are not preserved. Hyphenated words and special characters may need cleaning up. For a scanned document, use Digitize Documents to create a searchable PDF first, which uses English OCR, or use a dedicated OCR tool for other languages.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load and the tool shows an error. Very large files are read page by page, but the full text is kept in memory for display. For PDFs that use certain fonts, PDF.js can request character map files from the jsDelivr CDN to read the text correctly; the PDF itself is not sent. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Organize PDF does
paragraphs: Organize PDF shows thumbnails of every page in a PDF so you can reorder, rotate and delete pages visually, then saves a new file. The pages in the output are copies of the original pages, so text and graphics stay vector and the pages are not converted to images; only the thumbnails you see are small JPEG previews.

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Each thumbnail has buttons to move the page left or right, rotate it by 90 degrees and delete it. Rotation is added to the page's existing rotation, so rotating three times gives 270 degrees. The exported file contains the remaining pages in the order shown, and the tool will not export if no pages are left.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: For a long document, delete the pages you do not need first, then fix the order, and rotate last, so you have fewer thumbnails to track. The thumbnails are low resolution, so use them for identification only and check small details in the exported file. If you only need one kind of change, Delete Pages, Rotate or Split may be quicker. Download the result and check the page count before replacing the original.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Every page needs a thumbnail, so very long PDFs take time and browser memory before you can start. Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load or preview. Bookmarks, links and form fields that point between pages may not survive reordering, because pages are copied individually. The original file is unchanged. For some fonts, PDF.js can request character map files from the jsDelivr CDN to draw thumbnails; the document itself is not sent. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Master Document Studio does
paragraphs: Master Document Studio builds one PDF from several sources. You can add PDFs, Word (.docx) files and PNG, JPG or WebP images, see every page as a card, and arrange them into an output sequence. You can also add generated pages: a blank page, a cover or a note. You can then edit pages, set document options and download one final PDF.

sections.heading: Page and document options
paragraphs: Pages can be dragged into order, rotated, cropped and covered with black redaction boxes. Pinned pages can be given a title for a linked table of contents added at the start. Settings include output file name, title, author, subject and keywords; page size (A4, Letter or keep original); margin of 0, 10 or 20 mm; page numbers at bottom center, bottom right or top right using a format such as Page {page} of {total}; a text watermark with 10 to 80 percent opacity (default 25) and an angle from -60 to 60 degrees; and a compression mode of Maximum quality, Balanced, or a goal of under 2 MB or under 500 KB.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: Keep original size with 0 mm margins to preserve PDF pages most exactly, because those pages are copied as they are. Use A4 or Letter to unify mixed sources. Size goals work by saving image pages as lower-quality JPEG, so they mainly help image-based pages, they are estimates, and the tool reports when the result is above the goal. You can also export a single page as PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Word files are shown by rendering them in the browser, so layout can differ from Word, and their pages become images. Pages with redaction boxes, pages from password-protected PDFs and Word pages are rasterized; untouched PDF pages stay vector. The optional password protection rebuilds the document from page images, so text is no longer searchable and contents links are removed. Large sources use a lot of memory. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Image Converter does
paragraphs: Image Converter changes PNG, JPG and WebP images from one of those formats to another, and can handle several images in one go. It decodes each image in your browser, draws it to a canvas, and saves it again in the format you choose, keeping the original width and height.

sections.heading: Settings
